mapper.insert: INSERT INTO insurance_co_policy ( co_policy_id, co_policy_no, master_policy_no, insurer_code, insurer_name, share_ratio, share_amount, share_premium, is_remainder, co_policy_status, sort_order, created_at ) VALUES ( #{coPolicyId}, #{coPolicyNo}, #{masterPolicyNo}, #{insurerCode}, #{insurerName}, #{shareRatio}, #{shareAmount}, #{sharePremium}, #{remainder}, #{coPolicyStatus}, #{sortOrder}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO insurance_co_policy ( co_policy_id, co_policy_no, master_policy_no, insurer_code, insurer_name, share_ratio, share_amount, share_premium, is_remainder, co_policy_status, sort_order, created_at ) VALUES
( #{item.coPolicyId}, #{item.coPolicyNo}, #{item.masterPolicyNo}, #{item.insurerCode}, #{item.insurerName}, #{item.shareRatio}, #{item.shareAmount}, #{item.sharePremium}, #{item.remainder}, #{item.coPolicyStatus}, #{item.sortOrder}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM insurance_co_policy WHERE master_policy_no = #{masterPolicyNo} AND co_policy_status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY sort_order ASC
SELECT co_policy_status AS status, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM insurance_co_policy WHERE master_policy_no = #{masterPolicyNo} GROUP BY co_policy_status
mapper.update: UPDATE insurance_co_policy SET co_policy_status = #{coPolicyStatus}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE co_policy_id = #{coPolicyId}
UPDATE insurance_co_policy SET co_policy_status = 'CANCELLED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE master_policy_no = #{masterPolicyNo} AND co_policy_status != 'CANCELLED'
